passives.name: Emperor of Armageddon
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Grants Courage Against Despair to the enemy team. Grants a special effect to the enemy team based on their class. Striker: +50% Priority recovery efficiency Mage: Increased damage Defender: Inflicts reduced Defense on the Boss for 4 turns when performing an action Ranger: Inflicts reduced Resilience on the Boss for 4 turns when performing an action Healer: Fixes Priority recovery efficiency of the Boss to 60%
